from pathlib import Path

    '--plain-proxy', '--cases', 'proxy-1k', 'proxy-16k',
    '--workers', '2', '--concurrency', '64', '--rounds', '3',
    '--seconds', '15', '--warmup', '5', '--interleave',
    '--rgnix-transport', 'hyper', '--candidate-transport', 'hyper',
    '--client-threads', '4', '--client-cpus', '2,3,4,5',
    '--origin-workers', '4', '--origin-cpus', '6,7,8,9',
    '--server-cpus', '10,11',
]
result = {
    'source_commit': '6c54c95',
    'fixture_correction': 'Both use Host localhost, 5s upstream connect/read/write timeouts, 128 idle connections per worker (rgnix aggregate 256). An initial old-fixture run was interrupted and retained separately, never merged into formal results.',
    'rule': 'For each case: 3 interleaved same-binary A/A pairs per engine, 5s warmup and 15s measurement per window. All paired symmetric RPS differences and both sample CVs <=10%, zero errors. Run one predeclared interleaved rgnix/NGINX comparison regardless of gate outcome; failing A/A means diagnostic observations only, not a qualified relative throughput or optimization claim. No retries, window selection, or changes to settings.',
    'commands': [], 'calibration': {}, 'comparison': {},
}
environment = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('OTEL_', 'RGNIX_OTLP_'))}
def save():
    (work / 'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n')

def run(name, engines):
    output = work / f'{name}.json'
    command = ['python3', str(root / 'scripts/benchmark_compare.py'), *common,
               '--engines', *engines, '--work-dir', str(work / name), '--output', str(output)]
    result['commands'].append(command)
    save()
    subprocess.run(command, env=environment, check=True)
    return json.loads(output.read_text())

for name, engines in [('aa-rgnix', ['rgnix', 'candidate']), ('aa-nginx', ['nginx', 'nginx'])]:
    data = run(name, engines)
    result['calibration'][name] = {}
    for case in ['proxy-1k', 'proxy-16k']:
        runs = [r for r in data['runs'] if r['case'] == case]
        if name == 'aa-nginx':
            left, right = runs[::2], runs[1::2]
        else:
            left = [r for r in runs if r['engine'] == 'rgnix']
            right = [r for r in runs if r['engine'] == 'candidate']
        pairs = [200 * abs(a['rps'] - b['rps']) / (a['rps'] + b['rps']) for a, b in zip(left, right)]
        cvs = [100 * statistics.stdev(r['rps'] for r in group) / statistics.mean(r['rps'] for r in group)
               for group in [left, right]]
        result['calibration'][name][case] = {
            'paired_difference_pct': pairs, 'cv_pct': cvs,
            'passed': len(pairs) == 3 and max(pairs + cvs) <= 10 and all(r['errors'] == 0 for r in runs),
        }
    save()

data = run('comparison', ['rgnix', 'nginx'])
result['comparison'] = data['summary']
result['qualified'] = {
    case: all(result['calibration'][name][case]['passed'] for name in result['calibration'])
    for case in ['proxy-1k', 'proxy-16k']
}
save()
print(json.dumps(result, indent=2), flush=True)
